text: I'm probably panicking over nothing but I can't settle until someone tells me. My little boy is 3. We were out in the garden most of the afternoon and tonight at bath time I noticed he's got a few bites on him, three on one leg and one on his arm. They're little raised red bumps, like midge or mosquito bites. He keeps scratching at them and saying they're itchy. He's been totally himself otherwise, ate his dinner, played with his cars, went to bed fine and is asleep now. I've just never seen him with bites like this and I've been reading things online and frightened myself. I don't know if I should be putting something on them or if I need to watch for anything. My wife says I'm overreacting but I'd rather ask.
